Package gnu.x11.keysym

Class Latin3

java.lang.Object
gnu.x11.keysym.Latin3
public class Latin3 extends Object
Latin 3-specific keyboard symbols. Imported from XK_LATIN3 section of /usr/include/X11/keysymdef.h. Note that byte 3 = 0x02.
